note: every comma is dropped, not just grouped ones
the percent sign is removed, never divided by 100
the inner text is trimmed again after unwrapping
an explicit sign passes through untouched
negation is prepended blindly; the doubled sign is left to fail at coercion
only one trailing suffix is removed
interior whitespace is NOT a separator and survives
normalisation does not validate: a non-numeric string passes through
unwrapping needs both delimiters, so this is not treated as negation
whitespace only, empty after the trim
empty parentheses, rejected before the sign is applied
bare suffix, empty after the strip
